=== BDD-11：CLI --json 输出的时间字段带时区标记 ===
[A] pytest（CliRunner 内跑 create/list/get -j）：
...                                                                      [100%]
pytest exit = 0

[B] CLI 实跑（隔离 HOME + 隔离数据目录，create -j / list -j / get -j）：
Usage: python -m peekview create [OPTIONS] [PATHS]...

  Create a new entry.

Options:
  -s, --summary TEXT              Entry summary/description  [required]
  --slug TEXT                     Custom URL slug (auto-generated if not
                                  provided)
  -t, --tag TEXT                  Tags (can be specified multiple times)
  --expires-in TEXT               Expiration duration (e.g., '7d', '1h',
                                  '30m'). Default: configured via
                                  limits.default_expires_in. Use '0' for no
                                  expiration.
  --from-stdin                    Read file content from stdin
  -b, --base-url TEXT             External base URL for generated links
  -r, --remote-url TEXT           Remote server URL
  -v, --visibility [public|private]
                                  Entry visibility (default: public unless
                                  --team is used)
  -j, --json-output               Output as JSON
  --team TEXT                     Team slug to publish to (team-visible)
  -u, --user TEXT                 Username (required in local mode when --team
                                  is used)
  -h, --help                      Show this message and exit.

  Examples:

      peekview create file.txt -s "My code"

      peekview create src/*.py -s "Project" -t python

      peekview create -s "From stdin" --from-stdin < code.py

      echo "content" | peekview create -s "From pipe" --from

--- $ peekview list --help  (exit=0) ---
Usage: python -m peekview list [OPTIONS]

  List entries with optional filters.

  Examples:     peekview list     peekview list -q "python"     peekview list
  -t cli -t python     peekview list --status active     peekview list --team
  proj-a --user alice     peekview list --remote-url https://example.com

Options:
  -q, --query TEXT       Search query (FTS5 search)
  -t, --tag TEXT         Filter by tag
  -s, --status TEXT      Filter by status
  -p, --page INTEGER     Page number
  --per-page INTEGER     Items per page
  -r, --remote-url TEXT  Remote server URL (e.g., https://example.com)
  -j, --json-output      Output as JSON
  --team TEXT            Team slug to filter by
  -u, --user TEXT        Username (required in local mode when --team is used)
  -h, --help             Show this message and exit.

CLI --json 输出中检查时间字段 = 9 个；无时区标记 = 0 个
